settings.landedRoute.label: Verification of the work that lands
settings.landedRoute.why: The workflow the work that lands on this repository's line follows: a verification workflow of checks, which runs the gates its daoris.gates.json declares, as you accepted them. Its own route replaces its workspace's for the work that lands alone; how each piece of work moves before it lands stays as its other routes say.
settings.landedRoute.twin: In a terminal: `daoris driver workflow use <id> --repository {{repository}} --landed`
settings.landedRoute.choices: What verifies the work that lands on {{repository}}
settings.landedRoute.none: No verification workflow is saved here: `daoris driver workflow import <file>` makes one from a file marked `verification`.
settings.landedRoute.accepts: When you choose one, you accept the `daoris.gates.json` at its line's tip: its checks run those gates unasked, and an edit of it asks you again on the Workflow tab.
